## Overview

This was a group project that I did while on Erasmus in a corporate finance module.
I was in a group with one other student, and we were assigned to a company 
in the computer hardware industry: Supermicro. We had to conduct a financial analysis of the company 
and then perform a relative valuation using market multiples and a discounted cash flow.
